output.note: Federal FICA and net pay only; not tax advice. State/local withholding and state disability/unemployment employee contributions out of scope. federal_withholding_per_period is a declared input (e.g. from compute_federal_withholding, which must be called with the same tax_year), not recomputed here.
output.regulatory_basis: IRC 3101/3121 (FICA, https://www.irs.gov/publications/p15); SSA 2026 Contribution and Benefit Base ($184,500 OASDI wage base, https://www.ssa.gov/oact/cola/cbb.html); IRC 3101(b)(2) Additional Medicare Tax ($200,000 employer-withholding threshold, https://www.irs.gov/publications/p15).
